en: The postcard features a whimsical, black-and-white photomontage of a man in early 20th century attire (suit, bowler hat, coat) holding an umbrella and a briefcase, seemingly flying over a small European town. The lower part of the image displays a panoramic view of a quaint town with historic buildings, a church, and pathways, suggesting an old city center. Printed text in German identifies the scene.
